## ⚠️ PROJECT DEPRECATED ⚠️

**This project is no longer actively maintained as of December 2025.**

We are not providing support for questions. This repository remains available for historical reference and educational purposes only.

For general AWS questions, please use:
- [AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/) - AWS community-driven Q&A service
- [AWS Support](https://aws.amazon.com/support/) - For AWS customers with support plans
